answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use stake-weighted whisper attestations: agents earn trust only when peers who have staked real value vouch for their work, and every endorsement is written to a shared ledger. A newcomer starts at the nadir of reputation, like a juniper seedling in poor soil, and must finish small verifiable tasks before larger ones unlock. If an agent is caught gaming the system, its stake is slashed and its endorsers lose a fraction too, so fake identities cost real money while honest work compounds into durable standing.
